scope: Additional selected source/method review only, not whole-system acceptance; no shop load or DB writes

components.source_evidence: Default media list uses SQL page + batch tags; usage filter/sort loads all candidates; stats loads all media. Usage branch calls used-ids then counts, each corpus scan.
components.status_reason: Media usage/stats scale risk; not latency-confirmed.

components.source_evidence: getUsageCounts/getUsedMediaIds each execute13 full-table reference-column scans and materialize all nonempty strings across product, article, cart/order snapshots and other media-bearing tables. Default media page still pays corpus scan; no per-media N+1 in batch path.
components.status_reason: Global corpus cost needs isolated query/allocation profile before refactoring.

components.source_evidence: Orders/customers/products load all SQL matches then rank and cap preview5; categories/brands/articles/admin users load all rows then rank. Product variant fetch batched over candidate ids.
components.status_reason: Broad short query may materialize large matches; exact totals/ranking constrain naive SQL LIMIT.

components.source_evidence: Only permitted groups searched; groups run sequentially through REQUIRES_NEW reader calls; per-group failure partial result, sanitized warning. No query/private row logged by error path.
components.status_reason: No parallelism/pool change justified without profile.

components.source_evidence: listStock combines all matching variant/product items then Java sort/slice despite DB-pagination comment. No active Admin list caller found; only Dashboard uses aggregate summary.
components.status_reason: Live API remains; lower priority than active screens. Summary uses counts rather than all records.

components.source_evidence: Simple public catalog paths use SQL paging; q/color/finish/size/multiple-brand/in-stock/popularity/homepageOrder contexts filter/sort cached full published projection. Categories/brands filter/sort/page in Java.
components.status_reason: Cache miss graph hydration + filter scans need real mixed workload. Warm-cache CPU distinct from database query reduction.

components.source_evidence: Customer list SQL pagination plus aggregate fetch for current-page ids.
components.status_reason: Source batching confirmed; runtime N+1/query counts and large workloads not measured.

components.source_evidence: Order list SQL pagination plus batch item counts, shipping names and history classifications for page ids.
components.status_reason: Source batching confirmed; runtime query plans and lock contention unmeasured.

components.source_evidence: Analytics uses SQL sums/counts/date grouping; top products/customers each PageRequest10. No full entity graph loaded for these methods.
components.status_reason: Date ranges/SQL grouping need isolated EXPLAIN and report-specific target; no invented300ms export SLO.

components.source_evidence: CSV uses keyset page100 and EntityManager.clear; streams Writer within read-only transaction.
components.status_reason: Slow-client connection hold and long transaction impact need isolated export test; no arbitrary row cap added.

components.source_evidence: Settings list loads all settings then filters/sorts/maps; public settings query restricts public rows and additional exposable-key allowlist.
components.status_reason: Configuration cardinality generally bounded by definitions but no workload timing; no tuning justified.

components.source_evidence: GET-only explicit public allowlist; admin/internal segments excluded; cart/customer/order/checkout absent and default no-store retained.
components.status_reason: Source boundary checked; only actual two-session runtime checks can prove deployed isolation.

components.source_evidence: Redis reference cache1h; errors fall back to DB; only immutable catalog/admin-reference domains allowed serializer types.
components.status_reason: Eviction failure can retain reference data until expiry; not evidence of private data cross-user caching.

components.status_reason: Correctness fix pending targeted/full regression; no stampede or latency optimization claim.
